also_called: Documentation Extraction; Exhaustion Yield; Form Gatekeeping; Internal Exhaustion Prerequisite; Paper Terrorism; Procedural Embedding; Sludge

name: Vague Allegations with High Consequences
definition: Undefined charges attached to real punishment.

name: Confidentiality as Weapon
definition: "We can't tell you" used to prevent defense.
also_called: Confidentiality Binding; Confidentiality Weaponization; Opacity Shield; Privacy Weaponization

name: Resource Sabotage / Sabotaging Success
definition: Removing what you need to succeed.
also_called: Resource Consequence; Resource Sabotage; Sabotaging Success

name: Administrative Escalation
definition: Issues becoming formal processes as punishment for speaking up.
also_called: Intervention Cascade; PIP Weaponization; Professional Degradation

name: "Managed Out" Through Exhaustion
definition: Slowly draining you until you leave "voluntarily."

name: Legal / Administrative Threats
definition: Using the threat of process to intimidate.

name: False Reports
definition: Fabricated complaints to create institutional jeopardy.

name: Location Tracking
definition: Monitoring physical presence as a control mechanism.

name: Device Access Demands
definition: Forced surrender of personal technology and privacy.

name: Account Control
definition: Someone else controls your accounts, phone number or digital identity, by demanding access or by taking it.

name: Response-Time Policing
definition: Punishment for not being available fast enough.

name: Moral Licensing / Strategic Philanthropy
definition: Using a "good" identity as immunity from accountability.
also_called: Moral Licensing; Strategic Benevolence; Strategic Benevolence / Strategic Philanthropy; Strategic Philanthropy; Virtue Signaling as Shield

name: Moral Framing
definition: Recasting your resistance as a character failing.

name: Financial Control
definition: Restricting access to resources to enforce compliance.
also_called: Economic Abuse; Economic Coercion; Financial Isolation

name: Sexual Coercion
definition: Using power to override consent.

name: Reproductive Coercion
definition: Controlling reproductive choices through institutional pressure.

name: Extinction Bursts
definition: Dramatic escalation when control methods stop working.

name: Negative Reinforcement Traps
definition: Applying pressure until compliance, then removing it — training that compliance equals relief.

name: Phobia Indoctrination / Catastrophizing
definition: Exaggerating consequences to extract compliance.

name: Strategic Chaos / Crisis Manufacturing
definition: Constant emergencies preventing strategic thinking.

name: Time Control
definition: Dictating how every hour is spent to prevent autonomous thought.

name: Sleep Deprivation
definition: Disrupting rest to reduce cognitive and emotional resistance.

name: Narrative Monopoly
definition: Controlling the dominant story so alternative accounts can't gain traction.

name: Mobility Control
definition: Restricting physical movement to enforce submission.

name: Body Autonomy Violations
definition: Controlling the physical body under institutional justification.

name: Role Assignment
definition: Assigning fixed identities that dictate expectation and treatment.
also_called: Identification as Identity Assignment; Identity Narrowing; Role Confinement

name: Forced Dependency
definition: Eliminating the ability to function outside the system.
also_called: Dependency Engineering; Dependency Installation; Device Dependency; Ecosystem Embedding

name: Silence as Policy
definition: Making certain topics undiscussable through emotional consequence.
also_called: Challenge Suppression; Organizational Silence Engineering; Permanent Silencing

name: Children as Leverage
definition: Using children's wellbeing as a tool of control over adults.

name: Micromanagement
definition: Controlling minute details to erode autonomous function.
also_called: Algorithmic Management; Autonomy Displacement; Pattern Recognition as Evaluation; Teacher Displacement

name: Performance Monitoring
definition: Constant evaluation that installs hypervigilance.

name: Controlled Communication
definition: Dictating how, when, and whether you may speak.
also_called: Communication Chain Restriction; Constraining Verbal Expression; Vocal Regulation

name: Rage as Regulation
definition: Using anger or its threat to control the environment.

name: Fear Installation
definition: Creating persistent dread through unpredictable consequences.

name: Managed Perception
definition: Controlling how the system appears to outsiders.

name: Omnipresence / Demonstrating Omnipotence
definition: The sense that the system is always watching, always present, always ahead of you.

name: Punishment by Proxy
definition: After a conflict between two people, trouble arrives for a third person the target cares about.

name: Emotional Blackmail
definition: A request is tied to the relationship: do this, or the closeness, approval or safety you rely on will be withdrawn.
also_called: Conditional Safety; Emotional Blackmail via Implicit Consequence; Revocation Threat

name: Intimidation
definition: Danger is communicated without being stated outright: through words, posture, size, closeness or what is done in front of you.
also_called: Form Intimidation; Implied Threat; Nonverbal Dominance; Postural Dominance; Spatial Invasion; Threats of Harm; Withdrawal Pressure

name: Concern Trolling / Shame-as-Governance
definition: Control or criticism is wrapped in the language of worry, so objecting makes you look ungrateful for the care.
also_called: Concern Masking; Concern Trolling; Shame-as-Governance; Shame-as-Governance Disguised as Advice

name: Ultimatums
definition: A demand is paired with a loss and a deadline, leaving no room to discuss either.

name: Loyalty Binds
definition: Speaking about a problem is framed as betraying the family, group or cause, so loyalty requires silence.

name: Ambient Sexual Threat
definition: Remarks about your body, sexual jokes and unwanted closeness create a climate in which you feel at risk, without any single act that is easy to report.

name: Overcorrection Demands
definition: After a small mistake, the response demanded, such as apologies, rituals or self-punishment, is far out of scale.

name: Blackmail / Leverage Exploitation
definition: A demand comes with a threat to expose something about you, or an old secret or debt is kept in reserve as leverage.

name: Moral Outrage as Weapon
definition: Public outrage is directed at a person in a way that skips any check of what they actually did.

name: Emotional Hostage-Taking
definition: One person's distress rises and falls with your choices, so you end up managing their state instead of making your own decisions.

name: "I Know Best" Paternalism / Velvet Glove Control
definition: Another adult decides what is good for you and acts on it, overriding your own choices as being for your own good.
also_called: "I Know Best" Paternalism; Using Privilege; Velvet Glove Control

name: Interrogation
definition: Questions come in a rapid, repeated, accusing stream, so answering feels like a trial rather than a conversation.

name: Moving-in-Silence
definition: Something large that will change your life is decided and arranged without you, and you learn about it when it is done.

name: Enforcing Trivial Demands
definition: Small rules with no clear purpose are enforced strictly, so obedience itself becomes the point.

name: Choice Restriction
definition: Your realistic options are narrowed through money, access, information or framing until only the wanted choice remains, while you are told the choice is yours.
also_called: Bounded Choice; Coercive Framing; Institutional Adoption; Reflexive Control; Token Autonomy; Token Autonomy / Coercive Framing

name: Pseudo-Consultation
definition: A consultation, survey or listening session happens in form, but the decision was already made and does not change.
also_called: Pre-Decision Concealment; Process Performance; Structural Dilution

name: Weaponized Inclusion / Strategic Containment
definition: Critics are invited inside, onto a committee or into a process, where their energy is absorbed and their voice contained.
also_called: Critique Absorption; Dissent Absorption; Inclusion Capture

name: Controlled Opposition
definition: Resistance that looks independent is quietly guided or set up by the party it opposes.

name: Manufactured Consent
definition: Agreement that looks freely given rests on a narrowed picture, on pressure, or on silence counted as a yes.
also_called: Consent Fabrication; Democratic Validation; Mutual Agreement Fabrication; Silence Harvesting

name: Sacred Science
definition: The group's founding ideas are placed beyond evidence or question, so doubting them is treated as a flaw in the doubter.

name: Doctrine Over Person
definition: A member's own experience is never allowed to count against the doctrine; when they clash, the person is wrong.

name: Forced Confession / Self-Criticism Rituals
definition: Members must regularly confess faults or criticize themselves before others, and what they say is kept and can be used later.

name: Algorithmic Manipulation
definition: Feeds and recommendation lists decide what you see first and most often, steering attention and mood in ways you cannot see.

name: Biometric Exploitation
definition: Signals of how you feel, read from your face, voice or body by cameras, microphones and wearables, are used to influence you.

name: Institutional Capture
definition: Influence is gained over the bodies meant to provide oversight, or outside structures are lined up to enforce, so the place you would turn to for help is already on their side.

name: Arbitrary Authority
definition: Decisions follow no stated rule, so nothing you do reliably changes the outcome.

name: Black-Box Decisions
definition: Consequential decisions come from a system whose workings cannot be seen, explained or meaningfully questioned.
also_called: High-Stakes Consequence; Invisibility of the Mechanism

name: Celebration as Cover
definition: Overwork, self-funding or sacrifice is praised in public as dedication, so the shortage that required it is never fixed.
also_called: Celebration Capture; Celebration as Extraction Cover

name: Closed-Loop Appeals
definition: Challenging a decision sends you back to the same people, rules or system that made it.

name: Collective Punishment
definition: A whole group is punished for something one person did, or for something no one is named for, so the group turns its pressure inward.
also_called: Collective Consequence; Incident Identification Without Individual Accountability

name: Data Harvesting
definition: Detailed information about behavior, location, feelings or performance is collected continuously and built into a profile, far beyond what the service needs.
also_called: Ambient Data Collection; Data Accumulation; Data Point Extraction; Profile Construction

name: Data Onward Sharing
definition: Information collected for one purpose is passed, sold or shown to others, often described as anonymized, without the person's real knowledge.
also_called: De-identification Laundering; Non-Consensual Distribution; Secondary Market Exploitation

name: Development Subordination
definition: A person's own learning, health or future is ranked below their usefulness to the system, and that ranking is presented as opportunity.

name: Initiative Churn
definition: New programs are launched one after another, so activity looks like progress while none runs long enough to be judged.

name: Labor Extraction
definition: Work, time, care or personal money beyond what was agreed or paid is expected and uncounted, often because the role has grown too big or because stopping would hurt the people you serve.
also_called: Administrative Displacement; Compassion Exploitation; Invisibility of Clinical Labor; Performance Extraction; Personal Subsidy Extraction; Ratio Exploitation; Role Inflation; Role Overload

name: Liability Reframing
definition: A duty to protect or repair is handed to legal or risk management and treated as exposure to limit, then declared expired, out of scope or not owed.

name: Metric-Mission Substitution
definition: The numbers chosen to measure a purpose quietly replace the purpose, and people are judged on the numbers.
also_called: Engagement-Learning Conflation; Metric Installation; Metric Substitution

name: Motivation Displacement
definition: Points, scores and rewards replace a person's own reasons for doing something, so they stop when the reward stops.
also_called: Intrinsic Motivation Displacement; Intrinsic-Extrinsic Displacement; Joy Extinction

name: Predictive Tracking
definition: People are routed into tracks, groups or labels on the strength of a prediction, and the track then limits what they are offered and can become.
also_called: Automatic Sorting; Intervention Channeling; Track Solidification

name: Strategic Delay
definition: Responses, records or decisions are slowed until deadlines pass, evidence fades or the person gives up.
also_called: Access Delay; Recommendation Deferral; Timeline Elongation; Timeline Exploitation

name: Strategic Timing
definition: Damaging information or sudden pressure arrives just before an important moment, leaving no time to check or respond.

name: Structural Underfunding
definition: The service meant to help is kept too small, too thinly staffed or too run-down to work, and its failure is treated as nobody's fault.

name: Harm to Pets or Property
definition: Belongings are destroyed, or a pet is harmed or threatened, as a warning of what could happen next. (Treat as a safety risk: contact local emergency or domestic violence services.)

name: Coerced Debt
definition: Loans, credit or bills are taken out in your name, or you are pressured into them, without real consent, so you carry debt for someone else's control.

name: Debt Bondage
definition: Fees for travel, housing, training or recruitment are charged against future earnings and keep growing, so you must keep working to pay a debt that never clears.

name: Document Confiscation
definition: Passports, identity papers, visas or certificates are taken "for safekeeping", so leaving, travelling or proving who you are depends on someone else.

name: Status Threats
definition: Your visa, residency, enrollment or legal status is used as a threat: comply, or you or your family could be reported, removed or deported. (Route to independent legal advice and support services.)

name: Enmeshment
definition: The line between two people's feelings, choices and identities is dissolved, so your moods, decisions and successes are treated as belonging to someone else. (A family-systems concept.)

name: Apologies Without Repair
definition: Performed remorse with no change.

name: Pity Plays
definition: Performing victimhood to prevent accountability.
also_called: Strategic Self-Deprecation; Strategic Self-Deprecation / Performed Humility; Strategic Vulnerability; Strategic Vulnerability / Weaponized Tears; Weaponized Tears

name: Forced Forgiveness / Weaponized Forgiveness
definition: "Move on" before harm is processed.

name: Competitive Victimhood
definition: Responding to your pain with their bigger pain.

name: Aftercare Control
definition: "That was for your good" reframing harm as help.

name: Legal Abuse
definition: Lawsuits, court filings and legal processes are used to drain, punish or silence someone, for example after they leave or speak out. (Route to qualified legal advice.)

name: Humiliation Rituals
definition: Degradation disguised as development.

name: Public Exposure
definition: Being singled out for shaming.
also_called: Public Humiliation; Public Identification; Public Shaming

name: Ghosting as Control
definition: Disappearing without closure.

name: Sudden Devaluation
definition: An abrupt shift from investment to disposal.

name: Replacement Display
definition: Publicly showcasing your replacement to signal your disposability.

name: Blame Discard
definition: Framing the discard as the target's fault.

name: Managed Exit
definition: Orchestrating the departure to maximize the system's control over the narrative.

name: Manufactured Closure
definition: The matter is declared resolved or closed by the side that caused it, without the harmed person agreeing and without the harm being named.
also_called: Closure Manufacture; Quiet Resolution; Resolution Without Acknowledgment; Unilateral Resolution

name: Paid Silence
definition: Money, a reference, a role or another benefit is offered in exchange for not speaking about what happened.

name: Punitive Transfer
definition: After raising a concern, the person is moved to a different place, team, class or role, presented as routine.

name: Record Erasure
definition: Records, files or evidence of what happened are deleted, lost or sealed, so the event can later be denied.

name: Uncorrected Record
definition: The accusation is public, loud and lasting, while any correction is quiet or missing, so the first version stays.

name: Values-Fit Pretext
definition: A person's results or questions are redescribed as a mismatch with the group's values or culture, which becomes the reason they have to go.

name: Visible Impunity
definition: The person reported faces no visible consequence, which tells everyone watching that reporting does not work.

name: Swatting
definition: A false emergency report brings an armed or emergency response to someone's home or school, using the authorities as a weapon. (Treat as an emergency safety risk.)

name: Orbiting
definition: Watching from a distance to maintain psychological presence after discard.

name: Infantilization
definition: Treating competent people as incapable to maintain dependence.

name: Parentification
definition: Forcing someone into a caretaker role that reverses the natural hierarchy.

name: Emotional Blackmail via Self-Harm Threats
definition: Threatening collapse to prevent departure or boundaries.

name: Health Sabotage
definition: Interfering with wellbeing to maintain dependence or instability.

name: Coordinated Reporting
definition: Attempting to remove your voice.

name: Context Collapse
definition: Communications stripped of context to change meaning.
also_called: Context Collapse Exploitation; Context Elimination; Context Stripping; Evidence Traps; Moment Extraction

name: Doxxing
definition: Publishing private information to intimidate.

name: Forged Screenshots / Edited Evidence
definition: Fabricated or altered evidence presented as proof.
also_called: Deepfake Video/Audio; Deepfakes; Edited Recordings; Fabricated Evidence; Forged Screenshots

name: Guilt Legacy
definition: Inherited obligation used across generations.

name: Maternal Gatekeeping
definition: Positioning oneself as the authority over your development to undermine confidence.

name: Smart-Home Coercion
definition: Connected home devices such as cameras, locks, thermostats and speakers are used to monitor, unsettle or control someone living there.

name: AI Voice Cloning
definition: Software produces speech that sounds like a specific real person, used to deceive the people who know that voice.

name: Intimate Image Abuse
definition: Real or fabricated intimate images of a person are shared, threatened or used against them without consent. (Treat as an emergency: tell a trusted adult and contact the platform and police or specialist services.)
also_called: Deepfake / AI Voice / SIM Swap / Intimate Image Abuse / Smart-Home Coercion

name: Accountability Reset
definition: A change of leader, name or program is treated as a fresh start, so earlier promises and failures no longer count against anyone.
